subject: DPA, SCCs & DPIA scoping for Riverbend County Schools procurement
messages:
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@riverbend.org>
To: rachel_kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@riverbend.org
Date: 2026-09-05T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Request: DPA + SCCs and DPIA scoping for Riverbend County Schools RFP

Hi Rachel,

Riverbend County Schools is running an RFP for provider-hosted AI inference services and procurement has asked us to gather the following from shortlisted vendors:

- A proposed Data Processing Addendum (DPA) aligned to EU SCCs (if applicable) and a clear statement on whether you accept SCCs or equivalent safeguards.
- A completed SCCs request form (attached) — specific to cross-border transfers.
- Any FedRAMP-adjacent controls you can provide in lieu of full FedRAMP, and whether you maintain evidence of those controls.
- A DPIA scoping worksheet (attached) — we need answers to the scoping questions and any suggested mitigations.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the DPA + SCCs language and a redacted SOC 2 report by next Wednesday (2026-09-09)? Procurement would also like a short timeline for DPIA scoping + any required input from our side.

Thanks — appreciate a quick turnaround.

Alicia
Alicia Moreno
Senior Procurement Analyst
Riverbend County Schools

Attachments: Riverbend_SCCs_request.pdf, Riverbend_DPIA_Scopesheet.xlsx
From: rachel_kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@riverbend.org>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-05T10:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Request: DPA + SCCs and DPIA scoping for Riverbend County Schools RFP

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear list and the attachments. We can provide the DPA and SCCs language and a redacted SOC 2 report. I'm looping in Marissa from Security to confirm the artifacts and DPIA scope.

Proposed next steps:
- Security to attach redacted SOC 2 & SIG/CAIQ answers (Marissa).
- I'll send a draft DPA addendum with SCCs language for legal review.
- We can complete the DPIA scoping worksheet; we may need a brief call to clarify data flows (approx 30 mins).

Timeline: aiming to have docs to you by 2026-09-09 EOD; DPIA scoping draft by 2026-09-11, followed by a short call the week of 9/14 if needed. Does that work for procurement?

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: rachel_kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@riverbend.org>, procurement@riverbend.org
Date: 2026-09-05T13:20:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Request: DPA + SCCs and DPIA scoping for Riverbend County Schools RFP

Thanks Rachel — quick note from Security. We can deliver the following artifacts by 9/09:

- Redacted SOC 2 Type II report (attachment: Redwood_SOC2_cert_redacted.pdf).
- SIG/CAIQ mapping we maintain internally (we will provide the export as a PDF).
- Statement on SCCs: Redwood accepts the EU SCCs for controller-to-processor transfers; for public-sector procurements in the US we offer equivalent contractual safeguards and a standard SCCs annex we can include in the DPA.

DPIA scoping: based on the scoping sheet you shared we have a few follow-ups where we need concrete answers from your side to finalize impact levels:
- Which categories of pupil data will be processed (PII, special categories, IEP-related records)?
- Expected max concurrent session counts and retention window required by policy.
- Any local/State retention mandates that supersede our defaults.

If you can provide that in advance we'll populate the scoping sheet and propose mitigations (encryption at rest/in-transit, role-based access, retention/deletion automation, and SCCs-based cross-border controls).

Attaching: Redwood_SOC2_cert_redacted.pdf (attachment stub).

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: rachel_kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T09:08:00-05:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: DPA + SCCs and DPIA scoping for Riverbend County Schools RFP

Sean — forwarding Riverbend's request. Procurement wants DPA language that can be signed as an addendum. Security has provided the redacted SOC2 and confirmed SCCs approach.

Key negotiation points (suggested):
1) Retention: propose default 90-day kernel cache retention; customer-controllable long-term logs with SLA for deletion on termination (30 days).
2) SCCs: accept EU SCCs or county equivalent; include standard annex and signature page.
3) DPIA assistance: Redwood will complete scoping worksheet but will not own the controller-side decisions; recommend a 30-min scoping call with their DPO and our Security SME.
4) FedRAMP-adjacent controls: we will provide mapping of control objectives to NIST 800-53 controls we satisfy.

Can you draft a short DPA addendum and include the SCCs annex? I've attached the procurement forms from Riverbend for reference.

Thanks — Rachel

Attachment: Riverbend_SCCs_request.pdf, Riverbend_DPIA_Scopesheet.xlsx

Subject: Proposed DPA addendum and next steps (Riverbend County Schools)

Alicia — attaching a proposed DPA addendum (see link) that includes:
- SCCs annex (we accept EU SCCs for cross-border transfers or the County may attach an equivalent instrument).
- Retention and deletion commitments with options for longer retention subject to procurement.
- Roles & responsibilities, subprocessors list (we will provide the current list under a separate cover).

Link to draft: https://docs.redwood.com/sccs-template-v2 (attachment placeholder).
DocuSign: We can send this through DocuSign once Riverbend confirms the annex and retention windows.

Requested from Riverbend:
- Confirmation on categories of pupil data that will be processed.
- Any State-specific retention mandates.

Proposed timeline: legal review & redlines by 2026-09-10; DocuSign by 2026-09-12 if no major redlines.

Thanks — Sean Gallagher
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Proposed DPA addendum and next steps (Riverbend County Schools)

Thanks Sean — draft looks good overall. A couple quick notes:

- We will send the DPIA scoping answers by Friday 9/11 (pupil data categories + retention guidance).
- Procurement requests evidence that automated deletion is in place for short-term caches; can you confirm the default cache retention settings and whether deletion logs are produced?
- We'd like to schedule the 30-min DPIA scoping call next week (availability Mon/Tue morning).

If those are confirmed we should be able to complete legal review on our side and route the DPA to our legal director for signature.

Appreciate the quick turnaround,
Alicia
